# Deny-list of occupational / employer / branding terms.
#
# THIS IS THE ONLY FILE IN THE REPOSITORY THAT IS ALLOWED TO CONTAIN THESE WORDS.
# It exists so scripts/scan-deny-list.mjs can fail the build if any of them ever
# appear in UI copy, seed data, placeholders, metadata, README, tests or schema.
#
# Syntax: one entry per line.
#   plain: <word or phrase>  -> matched case-insensitively with word boundaries
#   re:    <pattern>         -> raw regular expression (use sparingly)
#   #                         -> comment
plain: profession
plain: professions
plain: professional
plain: professionally
plain: professionals
plain: occupation
plain: occupations
plain: occupational
plain: job title
plain: jobtitle
plain: designation

plain: employers

plain: employed
plain: employee
plain: employee id
plain: colleague
plain: career
plain: resume
plain: curriculum vitae
plain: linkedin
plain: company
plain: companies
plain: corporate
plain: entrepreneur
plain: businessman
plain: freelancer
plain: freelance
plain: self-employed
plain: founder
plain: founders
plain: co-founder
plain: consultant
plain: consultants
plain: managing director
plain: chief executive
plain: work history
plain: work experience
plain: years of experience
re: \bCEO\b
re: \bCTO\b
re: \bCFO\b
re: \bCOO\b
plain: tagline
plain: brand ambassador
plain: organizational role
plain: organisational role
